caption: The drawing depicts a woman standing, dressed in 19th-century attire. She is wearing a large, voluminous dress made of red and dark blue tartan fabric arranged in a plaid pattern, with hints of green and black in the squares and thin yellow lines intersecting the design. The dress features puffed sleeves and a high, fitted waist. Over her shoulders is a light-colored, possibly lace, shawl or collar with detailed edging. She has brown gloves on both hands. Her head is covered by a decorative bonnet that has a checkered or textured gray appearance, adorned with ruffles and a large pink ribbon bow or accent. A white or light-colored scarf with blue stripes is tied around her neck and under her chin. Beneath the plaid skirt, she wears a beige underskirt and a blue petticoat, both visible at the hem. Her footwear consists of red shoes or boots. The background of the drawing is plain, in a cream or light beige color.
title: Doll in Plaid Dress
